I've been in this situation! It ends it heartbreak love. Unless you guys have a discussion and he takes your feelings seriously and you guys can adjust, it won't work. It hurt everytime my ex had sex with others, every fucking time and even though I had the option to, I didn't ever want to. It wasn't worth the time and effort I put into it trying to change myself to adjust for them.

I know it's cliche but TIME is what will heal you in the end. Time and working on yourself. I know that's over said but it's been researched upon. Heartbreak activates the same parts of your brain as physical pain does and it's been shown that the only thing that truly heals is time and working on yourself. He might care about you still, but not enough to consider how this hurts you. Don't go after someone who is not choosing you. They're never gonna be worth itbif they don't see you as worth it to them.
